name: Alert Slack when a customer champion changes jobs, with weekly LinkedIn checks through looot

parameters.content:
## Know when a champion moves to a new company

### How it works
1. Every Monday at 9, reads your Champions sheet: people who bought or used your product, with their LinkedIn URL and company.
2. looot reads each LinkedIn profile, falling back to the next provider when one misses.
3. If the current company on the profile is not the one in the sheet, the person moved.
4. Every row gets company_now, title_now, moved and checked_at. Each move posts to Slack with the new company and the profile link.

A champion at a new company already knows your product. That is the warmest outbound there is.

**Cost per champion per week**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: LinkedIn profile $0.0012. 100 champions cost about $0.12 a week. Each call is capped at $0.05, and a failed call costs $0.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- Google Sheets and Slack credentials. Set the spreadsheet ID in both Sheets nodes and the channel ID in **Post to Slack**.
- A sheet named Champions with the headers: full_name, linkedin_url, company, company_now, title_now, moved, looot_cost_usd, checked_at.

### Customization
After a move, update the company column so the next week compares against the new job. Add a HubSpot node on the moved branch.

## Who to check
Rows with a LinkedIn URL, up to 100.

## Profile today vs the sheet
One looot call per champion.

## Moves go to Slack
Every row is written back.
